text:
Maya: Quick design review—thinking about callpath collapse semantics in the trace viewer. Right now collapse happens per-frame, but users are confused when perf badges move around after collapse.
Arjun: Yeah, noticed that. Users expect the perf badge to stick to the top-level call or to the right edge consistently.
Sam: From an implementation POV it's easiest to keep the badge anchored to the call row, but we can animate its position to reduce perceived jump.
Maya: Animation helps but doesn't solve discoverability for keyboard users or screen readers. If position changes, focus order should remain deterministic.
Lena: Accessibility nit: the badge needs an aria-label that includes the metric name (+ value). Right now it's just an icon. Suggest: `aria-label=\"p99 latency: 120ms\"`.
Carlos: Copy tweak: do we call it \"perf\" or spell out \"performance\" in the UI? PMs asked for clarity for non-eng users.
Maya: Prefer \"performance\" in tooltips, but short label on badges can be \"Perf\" if we expose full text on hover/focus.
Arjun: Proposal: move perf badge into the left meta column (before the timestamp) so collapsing rows doesn't cause horizontal shifts. That way it's visually consistent.
Sam: If we move it left we need to ensure tokenization for narrow screens — currently the left column is tight. Could overflow hide the badge?
Maya: For narrow screens, we can hide the numeric and show just an icon with accessible label. Tooltip preserves full value.
Lena: Keyboard flow: badge should be reachable via Tab (skip to next actionable item) and not create extra stops when collapsed. Maybe make it focusable only when there's an explicit action (e.g., open metrics panel).
Carlos: Export action placement question: should Export trace be grouped with row actions (three-dots menu) or with top-level trace header? Users want export of single span and full trace.
Maya: My vote: keep span-level export in the row menu and add a prominent \"Download trace (JSON/ZIP)\" CTA in the header for full-trace export. Copy: header CTA = \"Download trace (JSON/ZIP)\". Row menu item = \"Export span\".
Arjun: Agree. Also add microcopy for correlation IDs — replace \"CorrID\" shorthand with full \"Correlation ID\" in screenreader-only text. Visual can stay shortened if space is tight.
Sam: Quick dev note: changing badge placement will require updating the sticky header logic and test fixtures. I'll add a ticket.
ux-bot: Reminder: design review checklist — include contrast check, keyboard nav test, screenreader walkthrough.
Maya: One more small copy ask: export modal title currently says \"Export\". Suggest \"Export trace data\" — more explicit.
Lena: Contrast check: the perf badge background at 0.6 alpha fails AA on small text. We should either increase contrast or use a border and white bg.
Carlos: Decision summary? Move badge to left meta column, show icon-only at small widths, improve aria-labels for badge and correlation ID, keep span export in row menu + header Download for full trace, and update export modal copy.
Maya: I'll update the mock and post updated screens. Sam, can you estimate dev effort for the badge move and keyboard adjustments?
Sam: Looks like ~2 dev days + QA for accessibility pass. I'll attach a draft PR when I start.
Maya: Perfect, thanks. Will follow up with annotated mocks and a11y checklist.
Arjun: +1 to timeline. Thanks everyone!
